title: Lazy Agent Service Runtime Execution Graph

nodes.label: HTTP Ingress — Express Boot, Route Mounts & SSE Frames
nodes.skip_or_fallback: GET /health is never traced and answers while optional backends are down so the 30 s docker healthcheck passes; unmatched mounts 404 with the endpoint registry logged at boot; an Accept: application/json request to /agent returns one JSON reply instead of SSE.

nodes.label: Session & Identity — AuthMiddleware, Session Registry, Durable Completions
nodes.skip_or_fallback: AuthMiddleware copies x-project/x-username for scoping and never authenticates (boundary guards per ch.12); a run keeps going when the client disconnects — /agent/stop is the only cancel (ADR-10); an unknown conversation or completion id is created lazily.

nodes.label: Model Router — Dynamic Resolution, vLLM Boxes, Jetson Gate, Provider Budget
nodes.skip_or_fallback: Nothing retries across boxes unboundedly; an unavailable box falls back per catalog profile, a box that fails the preflight is skipped for the run; catalog-first getModelProfile keeps unknown models on the reasoning-safe path (ADR-11); wallgarden jobs queue behind the Jetson gate.

nodes.label: Harness Loops — Core Tool Loop, Compaction, Guards, Harness² Recursion
nodes.skip_or_fallback: RunawayStreamWatch ends streams that produce nothing or loop; past the 240,000-char mission budget Harness² trajectories compact to start+end behind an explicit COMPACTED note; an all-failed base stops with base-failed and a failed selection never teaches the library (ADR-09); empty/cut proposer replies fail the attempt, they are never a silent KEEP_BASE.

nodes.label: Tool Dispatch — Schema Catalog, decideToolCall, MCP Client, Local Router, Sandbox
nodes.skip_or_fallback: One decision: decideToolCall feeds ApprovalGate; AutoApprovalEngine is gone (ADR-04). stdio MCP rows are refused unless the exact command is on MCP_STDIO_COMMANDS (ADR-06); code_interpreter fails closed when its boot probe sees any capability allowed (ADR-07); read-only repeats are reused, not re-paid (ADR-05); ensureSchemas() waits for an in-flight fetch so boot-window runs see the full catalog (f8c7737).

nodes.label: Trading Tool Bridge — Signed Context, Budget Guards, SSE Tool Stream
nodes.skip_or_fallback: A vllm-trading-bot call without the signed _lazy_trading_context is refused (forged → PERMISSION_DENIED); the tool budget counts resolved {error,is_error} payloads and bridge timeouts (e5611e9); scrape_url and closed-budget tools are never offered to trading runs (e7003c8); a run finalizes when no tool is offered after budget close (fb2ea8a); identical screener_query results reuse within a run (ebdda0d).

nodes.label: Web Search & Extract — Exa Search, scrape_url Budget, /execute API
nodes.skip_or_fallback: /execute 401s without EXECUTE_API_KEY when set; private-address targets and redirect hops are refused by the URL guard; non-URL text never charges the per-run scrape budget (174db2a) and known-dead URLs are refused without re-charging, pruned per run (a989f16); search-first hint on a malformed URL; rate-limit fallback per the shared web-search contract (ch.05).

nodes.label: Embeddings & RAG — EmbeddingGemma 2, Conversation Index, Memory Recall
nodes.skip_or_fallback: /embed takes one text or a texts batch of 1–32 against the shared embeddinggemma-2 queue on the Jetson; a down backend fails the call with a diagnostic rather than returning zero vectors; memory injection on a cold index degrades to no-context instead of blocking the run (ch.06).

nodes.label: Telemetry & Gates — OTLP Spans, Request Log Rows, Measured Quality Gates
nodes.skip_or_fallback: /health is never traced; every other request writes a prism.requests row with createdAt equal to timestamp (d8a3c10, pinned by RequestLoggerPrismParity.test.ts); a missing OTLP endpoint disables tracing (tracingEnabled false) without failing requests; npm run verify blocks CI on lint/type/test/dry/arch/prompt (ADR-08, ch.09).
